subject: [RFC PATCH 18/57] mm/collapse: install the destinations at PTE level

reviews.author: Kiryl Shutsemau (author)
reviews.summary: Author agrees that the collapse_abort_candidate() hunk is correct and will leave it as is, but plans to reorganize the install side by adding a new function called collapse_account_install()
reviews.raw_body:
Your code looks correct to me. I will take the collapse_abort_candidate()
hunk as is.

The install side I will organize slightly differently: a
collapse_account_install() that does the MM_ANONPAGES accounting in
addition to the KSM stuff, called from both install paths.

-- 
  Kiryl Shutsemau / Kirill A. Shutemov

2026-08-26.patch_summary: This patch adds functionality to install the destinations at PTE level in the mm/collapse code. It includes a verify step to ensure that the window is still the round's to publish, and an abort step to undo a frozen candidate that cannot be published. The patch also handles publishing, which involves updating the destination's rmap and LRU insertion before its PTEs are updated. Additionally, it adds a terminal layer for PMD-order candidates and includes code to handle zapped slots and racing MADV_DONTNEED operations.
